preconditions.description: Both rows and columns must be integers.
Both rows and columns must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: The returned list must have exactly 'rows' number of rows.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == columns for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each row in the returned list must have exactly 'columns' number of elements.

postconditions.expression: all(cell in ('O', 'X') for row in return_value for cell in row)
postconditions.description: Every cell in the grid must be either 'O' or 'X'.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0][0] == 'O' if rows > 0 and columns > 0 else True
postconditions.description: The top-left cell (0,0) must be 'O' if the grid is non-empty.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[r][c] == 'O' if (r + c) % 2 == 0 else 'X' for r in range(rows) for c in range(columns))
postconditions.description: A cell at (r, c) is 'O' if (r + c) is even, and 'X' if (r + c) is odd.
